questions.q: What is the full form of HTML?
questions.e: HTML is HyperText Markup Language, the standard language for describing the structure of web pages.

questions.q: A trail of links such as Home > Products > Laptops, shown at the top of a page to tell users where they are in the site hierarchy, is called ______.
questions.e: A breadcrumb trail shows the path from the home page to the current page and helps navigation. A site map is a separate page listing all pages.

questions.q: Which HTML tag and attribute combination is used to create a hyperlink to another page?
questions.e: The anchor tag <a> with its href attribute holds the destination address of the link.

questions.q: Which HTML tag is used to create an ordered (numbered) list?
questions.e: <ol> makes a numbered list, <ul> an unordered (bulleted) list and <dl> a definition list. <li> marks each item.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about HTML tables.
I. The `<th>` tag defines a header cell, which is bold and centred by default.
II. The `<tr>` tag defines a header cell.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only I is correct. <th> is the header cell tag. <tr> defines a table row, and <td> a data cell.

questions.q: Which of the following is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.e: HTML comments begin with <!-- and end with -->. The other forms are comment syntax in other languages.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an HTML5 semantic element?
questions.e: <font> is a presentational tag, deprecated in HTML5, and says nothing about the meaning of its content. nav, article and footer are semantic elements.

questions.q: Which image format commonly used on the web supports simple animation?
questions.e: GIF supports animated sequences of frames, but it is limited to 256 colours per frame.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about colour models.
I. RGB is the subtractive colour model used for computer monitors.
II. CMYK is the subtractive colour model used for printing.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only II is correct. Monitors emit light and use the additive RGB model. CMYK is subtractive and is used for printing.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a feature of Bootstrap?
questions.e: Bootstrap is a front-end framework and does not manage databases. It offers a responsive grid, CSS classes and JavaScript components.

questions.q: In the HTML `<body>` tag, which attribute sets the colour of hyperlinks that the user has already visited?
questions.e: vlink is the visited-link colour. link sets unvisited links and alink the colour of an active link while it is clicked.

questions.q: Which attribute of the `<hr>` tag in HTML removes the 3-D shading from the horizontal rule and displays it as a solid line?
questions.e: noshade makes the rule a solid colour. The size and width attributes set its thickness and length.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about AngularJS directives.
I. The `ng-model` directive binds an input field to a model variable with two-way data binding.
II. The `ng-app` directive defines the root element of an AngularJS application.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are true. ng-model gives two-way binding between input and model, and ng-app marks where the application starts.

questions.q: In jQuery, what does the statement `$("#demo").hide();` do?
o: Hides all elements with class demo
Hides the element whose id is demo
Hides all elements with the tag name demo
Deletes the element with id demo from the page
questions.e: The # prefix selects by id, as in CSS. hide() makes the element invisible by setting display to none, without removing it from the document.

questions.q: Sass is ______.
o: a JavaScript framework for single-page applications
a CSS preprocessor that adds variables, nesting and mixins
a markup language for mobile devices
questions.e: Sass (Syntactically Awesome Style Sheets) extends CSS with variables, nesting and mixins, and is compiled into plain CSS.

questions.q:
Regarding classic Visual Basic controls, consider the following.
I. The label shown on a CommandButton is set through its `Text` property.
II. The contents of a TextBox are set through its `Caption` property.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. A CommandButton uses Caption for its label and a TextBox uses Text for its contents.

questions.q: The web colour `#FF8000` corresponds to which decimal RGB triplet?
questions.e: Each pair is a hexadecimal byte: FF = 255, 80 = 8×16 = 128, 00 = 0. So the colour is (255, 128, 0), an orange.

questions.q: Which meta tag in the head of a page makes the layout width equal to the device width on a mobile browser, as needed for responsive design?
questions.e: The viewport meta tag controls the layout viewport on mobile browsers. Media queries in CSS then adapt the design to that width.

questions.q: Which web image format offers lossless compression, 24-bit colour and full alpha-channel transparency?
questions.e: PNG is lossless and supports true colour with an alpha channel. GIF is limited to 256 colours and JPEG is lossy with no transparency.

questions.q: What does the browser display for the following AngularJS markup?
questions.e: ng-init sets x to 5 and the expression in double curly braces is evaluated by AngularJS as 5 × 2 + 1 = 11.
